title: Urdu Sentiment Analysis Using Fine-tuned mBERT: A Comparative Study
venue: International Conference on Computational Linguistics (COLING) Workshop
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study of multilingual BERT models fine-tuned for Urdu sentiment analysis. We evaluate our approach on three benchmark datasets and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance with 87.3% accuracy, outperforming existing baselines by 4.2%.

title: Lightweight CNN for Diabetic Retinopathy Detection on Edge Devices
venue: IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI)
abstract: We propose MobileRetina, a lightweight convolutional neural network optimized for diabetic retinopathy grading on resource-constrained edge devices. Our model achieves 94.2% accuracy with 3.7M parameters, making it suitable for deployment in low-resource clinical settings.

title: Consistency Challenges in Distributed Task Scheduling: A Survey
abstract: This survey examines consistency models and fault-tolerance mechanisms in modern distributed task scheduling systems. We analyze 45 systems published between 2018-2024, identify open challenges, and propose a taxonomy for evaluating scheduler correctness under failure scenarios.
